'''August 2000 Terryville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Terryville, CT on 19 August 2000. [[Steve Brentson]] won it. It is known from Andrew Ledwith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1151">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-21-terryville-ct-8-19-00d1151/ terryville-ct-8-19-00], DeckTech (Andrew "Gadget" Ledwith, 21 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-21-terryville-ct-8-19-00d1151/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 19 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Terryville, CT
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 16
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Brentson]]
